entries.meaningZh: 相互连接的；彼此相通的
entries.en: Interconnecting doors allow the two hotel rooms to be used as a family suite.
entries.zh: 两间客房之间的连通门使它们可以合起来作为家庭套房使用。

entries.meaningZh: 寝具；此处使用常见不可数形式 bedding
entries.en: The shelter urgently needed clean bedding for the new arrivals.
entries.zh: 收容所急需为新来的人准备干净的寝具。

entries.meaningZh: 最新的；掌握最新情况的；标准拼写 up-to-date
entries.en: Please send me an up-to-date copy of the timetable.
entries.zh: 请发给我一份最新的时间表。

entries.meaningZh: I am 的缩略形式：我是；我正在
entries.en: I'm waiting outside the library with your umbrella.
entries.zh: 我拿着你的伞在图书馆外面等你。

entries.meaningZh: they had 的缩略形式：他们已经
entries.en: They'd already left by the time we reached the station.
entries.zh: 我们到车站时，他们已经走了。

entries.meaningZh: what is 的缩略形式：什么是；是什么
entries.en: What's the easiest way to get to the museum from here?
entries.zh: 从这里去博物馆怎么走最方便？

entries.en: A PLC coordinates the conveyor and its safety switches.
entries.zh: 可编程逻辑控制器协调传送带及其安全开关的运行。

entries.meaningZh: 毫升；标准单位符号 mL
entries.en: The jug has marks at intervals of 50 mL.
entries.zh: 量壶上每隔50毫升有一道刻度。

entries.meaningZh: Hm：验光术语中的显性远视
entries.en: The lecture notes distinguish Hm from latent hyperopia.
entries.zh: 讲义区分了显性远视和隐性远视。

entries.en: The footnotes are set in 9 pt type.
entries.zh: 脚注采用9点字号。

entries.meaningZh: Jnr：Junior的缩写，常用在人名后区分同名父子
entries.en: The invitation was addressed to Robert Hayes Jnr.
entries.zh: 请柬的收件人写的是小罗伯特·海斯。

entries.meaningZh: 核对表；清单；常见拼写 checklist
entries.en: She ticked off each item on the checklist before locking the office.
entries.zh: 她锁办公室门前，逐项勾选了核对表上的内容。

entries.meaningZh: NB：注意，源自拉丁语 nota bene
entries.en: NB: The last train leaves twenty minutes earlier on Sundays.
entries.zh: 注意：星期日的末班车提前二十分钟发车。

entries.en: Harbour Tools Ltd has moved to a larger warehouse.
entries.zh: 海港工具有限公司已搬入一个更大的仓库。

entries.en: Alice brought a spare notebook for her friend.
entries.zh: 艾丽斯给朋友多带了一本笔记本。

entries.en: Leave a 2 cm gap between the frame and the shelf.
entries.zh: 在框架与搁板之间留出2厘米的空隙。

entries.meaningZh: VOL：显示磁盘卷标及序列号的命令名称
entries.en: The manual explains the information displayed by VOL.
entries.zh: 手册解释了VOL显示的信息。

entries.en: The terminal communicates with the host through an ALI.
entries.zh: 终端通过异步线路接口与主机通信。

entries.meaningZh: CH：通道的缩写，常用于设备标识
entries.en: The audio input marked CH 2 is reserved for the second microphone.
entries.zh: 标有CH 2的音频输入口留给第二支麦克风使用。

entries.meaningZh: ADAMS：Advanced DAta Management System，一种访问持久数据的语言
entries.en: The programming course included a short example of data retrieval in ADAMS.
entries.zh: 这门编程课包含了一个用ADAMS检索数据的简短示例。

entries.en: The block diagram labels the data-input stage DI.
entries.zh: 框图用DI标记数据输入阶段。

entries.en: The team scheduled the software deployment for a quiet weekend.
entries.zh: 团队把软件部署安排在一个业务清淡的周末。

entries.en: The archive contains an interview with a former PLO representative.
entries.zh: 档案中有一份对巴勒斯坦解放组织前代表的采访记录。

entries.meaningZh: O：哦，啊；常见于诗歌、祈求或呼唤
entries.en: O, how I wish I had kept those letters!
entries.zh: 啊，我多么希望自己当初留下了那些信！

entries.en: The company circulated the draft internally before releasing it to the public.
entries.zh: 公司先在内部传阅了草稿，然后才向公众发布。

entries.en: The case study examines SEB's approach to managing several household brands.
entries.zh: 这份案例研究分析了赛博集团管理多个家用产品品牌的方式。

entries.en: Her valuation report explains why the company's WACC changed after the refinancing.
entries.zh: 她的估值报告解释了公司再融资后加权平均资本成本变化的原因。

entries.meaningZh: ho：嗬，喂；用于引起注意或表示惊讶
entries.en: Ho! There's someone waving from the far bank.
entries.zh: 嗬！对岸有人在挥手。

entries.meaningZh: WEA：英国工人教育协会，Workers' Educational Association
entries.en: He enrolled in a WEA evening course on local history.
entries.zh: 他报名参加了工人教育协会开设的地方史夜校课程。

entries.meaningZh: USL：美国联合足球联赛的名称
entries.en: The supporter kept an old USL match programme.
entries.zh: 这位球迷留着一本旧的美国联合足球联赛比赛手册。

entries.en: The maintenance diagram gives each SS a separate status indicator.
entries.zh: 维护示意图为每个子系统配有单独的状态指示灯。

entries.meaningZh: DHSS：英国原卫生和社会保障部，Department of Health and Social Security
entries.en: A faded DHSS stamp was still visible on the old application form.
entries.zh: 那张旧申请表上仍能看到一枚褪色的英国卫生和社会保障部印章。

entries.meaningZh: 后视的；用于观察车辆后方的
entries.en: She adjusted the rearview mirror before reversing out of the driveway.
entries.zh: 她倒车驶出车道前调整了后视镜。

entries.en: The network diagram shows the RAB between the terminal and the access network.
entries.zh: 网络示意图显示了终端与接入网之间的无线接入承载。

entries.meaningZh: Det.：detective，警探的人名前职衔缩写
entries.en: Det. Morris asked the witness to repeat the address.
entries.zh: 莫里斯警探请证人再说一遍地址。

entries.en: The catalogue lists MAS separately from the individual alcohols.
entries.zh: 目录把低碳混合醇与各种单一醇分别列出。

entries.meaningZh: 本质上；从内在性质上说
entries.en: The two proposals are intrinsically different, despite their similar titles.
entries.zh: 这两项提议虽然标题相似，但本质上不同。

entries.meaningZh: mel：蜂蜜的拉丁语名称，见于历史药学文献
entries.en: The historical glossary translates mel as honey.
entries.zh: 这份历史词汇表将mel译为蜂蜜。

entries.meaningZh: 同步；常用于 in sync 或 out of sync
entries.en: The subtitles were out of sync with the dialogue.
entries.zh: 字幕与对白不同步。

entries.meaningZh: EDNA：乙撑二硝胺的化学缩写
entries.en: The reference table lists EDNA among the nitramine compounds.
entries.zh: 参考表将乙撑二硝胺列在硝胺类化合物中。

entries.meaningZh: RSPB：英国皇家鸟类保护协会
entries.en: An RSPB volunteer helped the children recognise birds by their calls.
entries.zh: 一位皇家鸟类保护协会志愿者帮助孩子们通过叫声辨认鸟类。

entries.en: In this memory diagram, SB marks the bottom of the stack.
entries.zh: 在这张内存示意图中，SB标记栈底。

entries.en: The receiver's RO setting disables transmission.
entries.zh: 接收器的只接收设置会禁用发射功能。

entries.en: The article compares the SNP's position with that of the other parties.
entries.zh: 这篇文章比较了苏格兰民族党与其他政党的立场。

entries.en: Ari offered to collect the tickets on his way home.
entries.zh: 阿里主动提出回家路上去取票。

entries.en: Her older disc player could not read the UDF-formatted disc.
entries.zh: 她较旧的光盘播放器无法读取那张采用通用磁盘格式的光盘。

entries.meaningZh: ILP：即时线性规划，依输入所列展开
entries.en: The optimisation chapter introduces ILP after explaining ordinary linear programming.
entries.zh: 优化章节在解释普通线性规划之后介绍了即时线性规划。

entries.meaningZh: chub：鲤科的一类淡水鱼，雅罗鱼等
entries.en: A chub rose to the surface beneath the overhanging branch.
entries.zh: 一条雅罗鱼在伸出水面的树枝下浮到水面。

entries.meaningZh: BGS：英国地质调查局，British Geological Survey
entries.en: The student used a BGS map to compare the rock formations on either side of the valley.
entries.zh: 这名学生用英国地质调查局的地图比较山谷两侧的岩层。

entries.meaningZh: ono：or nearest offer，或接受最接近的报价
entries.en: The bicycle was advertised at £120 ono.
entries.zh: 这辆自行车的广告标价为120英镑，或接受最接近的报价。

entries.en: The museum offers guided tours in BSL.
entries.zh: 这家博物馆提供英国手语导览。

entries.meaningZh: PowerPC：一种处理器指令集架构的名称
entries.en: The museum keeps an old PowerPC computer beside a collection of software manuals.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一台旧PowerPC计算机放在一批软件手册旁。

entries.meaningZh: Cajun：美国路易斯安那州阿卡迪亚人后裔
entries.en: Our guide is a Cajun whose family has lived in Louisiana for generations.
entries.zh: 我们的导游是一位卡津人，他的家族世代居住在路易斯安那州。

entries.meaningZh: 令人愉快地；非常宜人地
entries.en: The little café was delightfully quiet after the lunchtime rush.
entries.zh: 午餐高峰过后，这家小咖啡馆安静得令人愉快。

entries.en: Yup, I've already put your bag in the car.
entries.zh: 是的，我已经把你的包放进车里了。

entries.meaningZh: bon：法语的好的，常见于借入短语 bon appétit
entries.en: She wished us bon appétit as she set the soup on the table.
entries.zh: 她把汤端上桌时，祝我们用餐愉快。

entries.en: Griffith added a handwritten note to the bottom of the letter.
entries.zh: 格里菲思在信的末尾添了一则手写附言。

entries.meaningZh: ritz：豪华；排场，常见于 put on the ritz
entries.en: They really put on the ritz for the anniversary dinner.
entries.zh: 他们为周年纪念晚宴着实大摆了一番排场。

entries.meaningZh: johnnie：小伙子；家伙，较旧式用法
entries.en: An eager young johnnie offered to carry her suitcase.
entries.zh: 一个热心的小伙子主动提出帮她提箱子。

entries.meaningZh: burrito：卷有馅料的墨西哥式面饼卷
entries.en: She ordered a bean burrito with rice and extra salsa.
entries.zh: 她点了一个加米饭和额外莎莎酱的豆馅墨西哥卷饼。

entries.en: The old inscription says that the land was holden by the abbey.
entries.zh: 古老的铭文说，这片土地曾归修道院持有。

entries.meaningZh: BARR：bump-and-run reversal，价格图表的一种反转形态
entries.en: The charting lesson used a historical price series to illustrate a BARR.
entries.zh: 图表分析课用一组历史价格数据说明BARR反转形态。

entries.meaningZh: pratt：疑似与prat混淆的非规范头，标准prat可指傻瓜
entries.en: I felt like a complete prat after locking myself out again.
entries.zh: 又一次把自己锁在门外后，我觉得自己简直是个笨蛋。

entries.meaningZh: blanc：法语的白的，见于葡萄酒名称等借入表达
entries.en: The wine list included a dry vin blanc from France.
entries.zh: 酒单上有一款来自法国的干白葡萄酒。

entries.meaningZh: Jr：Junior的缩写；小，用在人名之后
entries.en: The younger man signed the form as Daniel Reed Jr.
entries.zh: 那个较年轻的男子在表格上签下了小丹尼尔·里德的名字。

entries.en: A faded CND badge was pinned to his old canvas bag.
entries.zh: 他的旧帆布包上别着一枚褪色的核裁军运动徽章。

entries.meaningZh: Dow：道琼斯工业平均指数的常用简称
entries.en: The newspaper printed the Dow's closing figure on its business page.
entries.zh: 报纸在商业版刊登了道琼斯工业平均指数的收盘数值。

entries.en: As an Eastender, she knew the neighbourhood's markets better than any guidebook.
entries.zh: 作为伦敦东区居民，她比任何旅游指南都熟悉这个街区的市场。

entries.meaningZh: roadwork：公路跑训练，尤指拳击等运动员的耐力训练
entries.en: His morning roadwork took him along the river and back through the park.
entries.zh: 他早晨的跑步训练路线沿着河边，再穿过公园返回。

entries.en: Umm, could you give me a moment to think?
entries.zh: 嗯，能给我一点时间想想吗？

entries.meaningZh: Penn：美国宾夕法尼亚大学的简称
entries.en: She met her future research partner during her first week at Penn.
entries.zh: 她在宾夕法尼亚大学的第一周就认识了后来一起做研究的伙伴。

entries.meaningZh: RAC：英国皇家汽车俱乐部的简称
entries.en: The exhibition included an old road map bearing the RAC logo.
entries.zh: 展览中有一张印着英国皇家汽车俱乐部标志的旧公路地图。

entries.meaningZh: RICO：美国《反有组织犯罪与腐败组织法》的简称
entries.en: The law seminar discussed the history of RICO.
entries.zh: 这场法学研讨课讨论了美国《反有组织犯罪与腐败组织法》的历史。

entries.meaningZh: Pegasus：希腊神话中的飞马珀伽索斯
entries.en: The book cover shows Pegasus flying above the clouds.
entries.zh: 书的封面画着飞马珀伽索斯飞翔在云层之上。

entries.meaningZh: TSB：Trustee Savings Bank的缩写，储蓄银行名称
entries.en: The archive holds a savings book issued by a local TSB branch.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着一本由当地储蓄银行分行签发的存折。

entries.meaningZh: Woodstock：伍德斯托克音乐节，尤指1969年的音乐节
entries.en: The documentary includes interviews with people who attended Woodstock in 1969.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片包含了对1969年伍德斯托克音乐节参加者的采访。

entries.meaningZh: bro：兄弟；哥们儿，非正式称呼
entries.en: Thanks, bro—you saved me a long walk home.
entries.zh: 谢了，哥们儿，你让我免去了很长一段回家的步行路。

entries.meaningZh: SDP：英国社会民主党的简称，历史政党语境
entries.en: Her history essay examines the SDP's early campaign leaflets.
entries.zh: 她的历史论文研究了英国社会民主党早期的竞选传单。

entries.meaningZh: DH：设计手册，按原资料的缩略用法
entries.en: The drawing refers readers to the DH for the complete dimensions.
entries.zh: 图纸请读者查阅设计手册，以获取完整尺寸。

entries.en: In the old travel diary, the author describes how they would gipsy around the countryside.
entries.zh: 在那本旧游记中，作者描述了他们如何在乡间四处漂泊。

entries.meaningZh: nowt：什么也没有，英国北部方言中的nothing
entries.en: There's nowt in the fridge except a bottle of milk.
entries.zh: 冰箱里除了一瓶牛奶什么也没有。

entries.en: The analytical chemistry glossary lists DPP alongside other electrochemical methods.
entries.zh: 分析化学词汇表把微分脉冲极谱法与其他电化学方法并列。

entries.meaningZh: louvre：百叶窗或百叶通风口的一片斜板
entries.en: Dust had collected on every louvre of the old ventilation grille.
entries.zh: 旧通风格栅的每一片百叶斜板上都积了灰。

entries.meaningZh: casa：家；房子，西班牙语借词或夹杂用语
entries.en: Welcome to our casa—make yourself comfortable.
entries.zh: 欢迎来到我们家，随意坐吧。

entries.meaningZh: SAO：Session-at-Once，光盘刻录中的区段刻录模式
entries.en: The disc-burning software offered SAO as one of its recording modes.
entries.zh: 光盘刻录软件把区段刻录列为可选模式之一。

entries.en: The page loads its menu from a separate JS file.
entries.zh: 这个网页从一个单独的JS文件加载菜单。

entries.meaningZh: NANA：历史上的北美报业联盟
entries.en: The reporter's NANA articles were preserved in a folder of newspaper clippings.
entries.zh: 这名记者为北美报业联盟撰写的文章保存在一个剪报文件夹里。

entries.meaningZh: POL：石油、油料及润滑剂的合称
entries.en: The logistics ledger has a separate section for POL supplies.
entries.zh: 物流台账为石油、油料及润滑剂物资设有单独栏目。

entries.meaningZh: och：哦，哎，常见于苏格兰或爱尔兰口语
entries.en: Och, don't worry about the broken cup.
entries.zh: 哎，别为那个打破的杯子担心了。

entries.meaningZh: GmbH：德语有限责任公司的缩写
entries.en: The invoice gives the supplier's legal form as GmbH.
entries.zh: 发票将供应商的法律组织形式写为有限责任公司。

entries.en: The instrument labels its two inputs Chan A and Chan B.
entries.zh: 这台仪器把两个输入口标为通道A和通道B。

entries.meaningZh: GCE：普通教育证书，英国考试资格名称
entries.en: Her application listed the GCE subjects she had studied at school.
entries.zh: 她的申请材料列出了在学校修读的普通教育证书考试科目。

entries.en: The lecture compared EFTA with other regional trade organisations.
entries.zh: 这堂课将欧洲自由贸易协会与其他区域贸易组织作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: nervosa：神经性的，见于拉丁医学名称中的限定成分
entries.en: The lecture used the full term anorexia nervosa rather than the shorter anorexia.
entries.zh: 讲课时使用了完整术语神经性厌食症，而不是较简短的厌食症一词。

entries.en: The specification gives the standby power in mW.
entries.zh: 规格说明以毫瓦标示待机功率。

entries.en: The exhibition catalogue reproduces a drawing from the RIBA collections.
entries.zh: 展览图录复制了一幅来自英国皇家建筑师学会馆藏的图纸。

entries.en: The science teacher used an ESA image to explain the shape of the coastline.
entries.zh: 科学老师用欧洲航天局的一幅图像解释海岸线的形状。

entries.en: The animation shows the container's rollover from three different angles.
entries.zh: 动画从三个不同角度展示了容器的翻转过程。

entries.meaningZh: TAE：Teaching Assessment Exercise，教学评估活动的缩写
entries.en: The department filed its TAE documents with the annual teaching reports.
entries.zh: 系里把教学评估活动的文件与年度教学报告一起归档。

entries.en: Kenton left a forwarding address with the building manager.
entries.zh: 肯顿给楼宇管理员留下了新的通讯地址。

entries.en: The old camera stores its photographs on an MMC.
entries.zh: 这台旧相机把照片保存在多媒体存储卡上。

entries.en: The pilot checked the CAA guidance before renewing her licence.
entries.zh: 这名飞行员续办执照前查阅了民航管理机构的指引。

entries.en: The engineering classroom had a box of old TI calculators.
entries.zh: 工程学教室里有一箱旧的得州仪器计算器。

entries.meaningZh: -fer：来自拉丁语，表示携带或产生
entries.en: The suffix in aquifer reflects its role as a water-bearing formation.
entries.zh: aquifer中的词尾体现了它作为含水地层的作用。

entries.en: The guide explained the word phnom while pointing to the hill on the map.
entries.zh: 导游指着地图上的小山解释了phnom一词。

entries.meaningZh: heh：嘿，表示轻笑、得意或惊讶
entries.en: Heh, I thought you might notice the missing cake.
entries.zh: 嘿，我就想你可能会发现蛋糕少了。

entries.en: Lal stayed behind to help stack the chairs.
entries.zh: 拉尔留下来帮忙把椅子叠放起来。

entries.en: The historian consulted the SFA archives for early match records.
entries.zh: 历史学家查阅苏格兰足球协会的档案，寻找早期比赛记录。

entries.en: A white marguerite stood in a small pot on the windowsill.
entries.zh: 窗台上的小花盆里长着一株白色雏菊。

entries.en: Machin returned the borrowed tools before sunset.
entries.zh: 梅钦在日落前归还了借来的工具。

entries.meaningZh: EQ：音频均衡器或均衡调节
entries.en: He adjusted the EQ to make the recorded voices clearer.
entries.zh: 他调整了均衡器，让录下的人声更清晰。

entries.en: The botany textbook has a chapter on hybridisation in garden plants.
entries.zh: 植物学教材有一章讲园艺植物的杂交。

entries.en: The circuit diagram places a CSA before the final adder.
entries.zh: 电路图把保留进位加法器放在最终加法器之前。

entries.en: The label identifies the white crystals as NaCl.
entries.zh: 标签将这些白色晶体标为氯化钠。

entries.en: The student compared statements issued by the OAS and the United Nations.
entries.zh: 学生比较了美洲国家组织与联合国发布的声明。

entries.meaningZh: FIS：家庭收入补贴，历史制度名称
entries.en: The archived form includes a section for applicants receiving FIS.
entries.zh: 这张归档表格设有供家庭收入补贴领取者填写的栏目。

entries.meaningZh: Ju：汉语姓氏或名字的罗马字形式
entries.en: Ju left a message asking us to call after lunch.
entries.zh: Ju留言请我们午饭后再打电话。

entries.en: The release was delayed while the QA team investigated a printing defect.
entries.zh: 质量保证团队调查一处印刷缺陷期间，发行被推迟了。

entries.en: The network map shows an FDP serving the three buildings.
entries.zh: 网络图显示，一个光纤分布点为这三栋楼提供接入。

entries.meaningZh: NGC：天文学中的星云星团新总表
entries.en: The atlas gives the galaxy's NGC number beside its photograph.
entries.zh: 星图册在星系照片旁标出了它的新总表编号。

entries.meaningZh: MHC：主要组织相容性复合体
entries.en: The immunology lecture introduced the term MHC before discussing antigen recognition.
entries.zh: 免疫学讲课在讨论抗原识别前介绍了主要组织相容性复合体这一术语。

entries.en: The table reports GAV separately from the monthly figures.
entries.zh: 这张表将年度总值与月度数值分开列示。

entries.meaningZh: deictic：指示的；依赖说话语境确定所指的
entries.en: Here and there are deictic expressions whose meanings depend on context.
entries.zh: here和there是其意义取决于语境的指示表达。

entries.en: The medical glossary explains what CRP stands for.
entries.zh: 医学词汇表解释了CRP这一缩写的含义。

entries.en: The annual report expresses oil production in bpd.
entries.zh: 年报以每日桶数表示石油产量。

entries.en: The neuroscience lecture discussed LTP in a chapter on learning and memory.
entries.zh: 神经科学课在学习与记忆一章中讨论了长时程增强。

entries.meaningZh: twelfths：十二分之一的复数形式
entries.en: The ruler divides each inch into twelfths.
entries.zh: 这把尺子把每一英寸分成十二等份。

entries.en: The maintenance plan lists each POU separately.
entries.zh: 维护计划将每个使用点分别列出。

entries.meaningZh: UCTA：尿液收集与转移组件，历史航天装备名称
entries.en: The museum caption identifies the UCTA as part of the astronaut's personal equipment.
entries.zh: 博物馆说明牌把尿液收集与转移组件列为航天员个人装备的一部分。

entries.meaningZh: SPR：Society for Psychical Research，心灵研究学会
entries.en: The archive contains correspondence sent to the SPR.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着寄给心灵研究学会的通信。

entries.en: Someone called him a fucker, and he left the room without replying.
entries.zh: 有人骂他是个混蛋，他一言不发地离开了房间。

entries.en: Seeing the ocean for the first time gave her a real thrill.
entries.zh: 第一次看到大海让她十分激动。

entries.en: We had to postpone the picnic because of the storm.
entries.zh: 因为暴风雨，我们不得不推迟野餐。

entries.meaningZh: wiki：允许用户协作编辑内容的网站
entries.en: The team keeps its onboarding instructions on an internal wiki.
entries.zh: 团队把入职说明保存在内部协作网站上。

entries.en: Her silhouette was backlit by the open doorway.
entries.zh: 敞开的门口从背后照亮了她的轮廓。

entries.en: Sterne carefully wrapped the photographs before posting them.
entries.zh: 斯特恩寄出照片前仔细包好了它们。

entries.meaningZh: shalt：shall的旧式第二人称单数形式
entries.en: Thou shalt find the answer in the final verse.
entries.zh: 你将在最后一节诗中找到答案。

entries.en: They changed trains in Bremen before continuing north.
entries.zh: 他们在不来梅换了车，然后继续北上。

entries.en: Madison brought an extra copy of the agenda.
entries.zh: 麦迪逊多带了一份议程。

entries.meaningZh: ripper：撕开或拆除东西的工具
entries.en: She used a seam ripper to remove the crooked stitching.
entries.zh: 她用拆线器拆掉了歪斜的缝线。

entries.en: The speaker described himself as a Mongol and spoke warmly of his family traditions.
entries.zh: 演讲者说自己是蒙古人，并热情地讲述了家族传统。

entries.meaningZh: Ulysses：尤利西斯，人名或文学作品中的名字
entries.en: Ulysses folded the map and placed it beside his notebook.
entries.zh: 尤利西斯折好地图，把它放在笔记本旁。

entries.en: The hikers caught their first glimpse of Mont Blanc at sunrise.
entries.zh: 徒步者在日出时第一次看见了勃朗峰。

entries.en: The specification cites a UNE standard for the material.
entries.zh: 规格说明引用了一项关于这种材料的西班牙标准。

entries.en: Her question provided a useful segue into the next topic.
entries.zh: 她的问题恰好为下一个话题提供了自然的过渡。

entries.en: Lauren offered to take notes during the meeting.
entries.zh: 劳伦主动提出在会上做记录。

entries.meaningZh: AUX：辅助输入或辅助设备接口
entries.en: She connected the music player to the speaker's AUX input.
entries.zh: 她把音乐播放器接到了音箱的辅助输入接口。

entries.en: He ordered a grande latte and a cheese sandwich.
entries.zh: 他点了一杯大杯拿铁和一个奶酪三明治。

entries.en: The class read a poem by Keats aloud.
entries.zh: 全班朗读了一首济慈的诗。

entries.en: The flat has a floor area of 62 sq m.
entries.zh: 这套公寓的建筑面积为62平方米。

entries.meaningZh: sur：法语的在……上，见于法语短语
entries.en: The note on the parcel read sur la table—on the table.
entries.zh: 包裹上的便条写着sur la table，意思是放在桌上。

entries.en: Marconi's name appears in the chapter on the history of radio.
entries.zh: 马可尼的名字出现在介绍无线电历史的那一章中。

entries.en: Woolworth wrote the date on the back of each photograph.
entries.zh: 伍尔沃斯在每张照片背面写下了日期。

entries.en: The jeweller lifted the tiny stone with a pair of forceps.
entries.zh: 珠宝匠用一把镊钳夹起了那颗小宝石。

entries.en: Lowry kept the fragile drawings between two sheets of card.
entries.zh: 劳里把易损的图画夹在两张硬纸板之间保存。

entries.en: The children did fantastically well in their first concert.
entries.zh: 孩子们在首次音乐会上的表现好极了。

entries.meaningZh: Faulkner：福克纳，姓氏；此处指作家威廉·福克纳
entries.en: The seminar compared Faulkner's narrative style with that of another novelist.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了福克纳与另一位小说家的叙事风格。

entries.en: Elgin signed the receipt and handed back the pen.
entries.zh: 埃尔金签好收据，把笔还了回去。

entries.en: Hadley remembered to leave a key with the neighbour.
entries.zh: 哈德利记得给邻居留了一把钥匙。

entries.en: René waited by the entrance with two concert tickets.
entries.zh: 勒内拿着两张音乐会门票在入口处等候。

entries.en: She fitted her OU coursework around a full-time job.
entries.zh: 她一边全职工作，一边安排开放大学的课程学习。

entries.en: Jensen found the missing page inside an old folder.
entries.zh: 延森在一个旧文件夹里找到了缺失的那一页。

entries.en: Benton stayed late to finish repairing the display.
entries.zh: 本顿留到很晚，把展架修好了。

entries.en: Condon asked for a table near the window.
entries.zh: 康登要了一张靠窗的桌子。

entries.meaningZh: yob：粗鲁、滋事的年轻人，英式贬义词
entries.en: A group of yobs had kicked over the bins outside the shop.
entries.zh: 一群滋事青年踢倒了商店外的垃圾桶。

entries.en: The study recorded participants' reported discomfort postoperatively.
entries.zh: 研究记录了参与者在手术后报告的不适。

entries.en: Our flight stopped in Dubai on the way home.
entries.zh: 我们回家的航班经停迪拜。

entries.en: The university emailed her CoE after processing the acceptance documents.
entries.zh: 大学处理完入学接受文件后，将入学确认书发给了她。

entries.en: They met for lunch in Dulwich before visiting the gallery.
entries.zh: 他们参观画廊前，在达利奇一起吃了午饭。

entries.en: Harcourt marked the route on a paper map.
entries.zh: 哈考特在纸质地图上标出了路线。

entries.en: Fawkes kept the spare batteries in a small tin.
entries.zh: 福克斯把备用电池放在一个小铁盒里。

entries.en: Lauder sent a brief reply confirming the appointment.
entries.zh: 劳德发了一封简短回复，确认了会面时间。

entries.meaningZh: conceptualise：把……构思成概念；形成概念
entries.en: The diagram helped us conceptualise the building as a series of linked spaces.
entries.zh: 这张示意图帮助我们把建筑理解为一系列相连的空间。

entries.en: The wet flag hung limply from the pole.
entries.zh: 湿旗子无力地垂在旗杆上。

entries.meaningZh: bicep：肱二头肌，biceps的非正式单数形式
entries.en: He rubbed his sore bicep after carrying the heavy boxes.
entries.zh: 搬完沉重的箱子后，他揉了揉酸痛的肱二头肌。

entries.meaningZh: Chiltern：英国奇尔特恩丘陵名称中的成分
entries.en: They spent Sunday walking in the Chiltern Hills.
entries.zh: 他们星期日在奇尔特恩丘陵徒步。

entries.en: The parcel was sent to her old address in Waltham.
entries.zh: 包裹寄到了她在沃尔瑟姆的旧地址。

entries.en: Conan arrived early and saved us two seats.
entries.zh: 科南早早到了，给我们留了两个座位。

entries.en: She bought a second-hand bicycle shortly after moving to Utrecht.
entries.zh: 搬到乌得勒支后不久，她买了一辆二手自行车。

entries.en: The biology textbook distinguishes fertilisation from the later stages of development.
entries.zh: 生物学教材区分了受精与之后的发育阶段。

entries.en: He chose a bottle of Pepsi from the fridge.
entries.zh: 他从冰箱里选了一瓶百事可乐。

entries.en: Brough carefully labelled the envelopes before sealing them.
entries.zh: 布拉夫封好信封前仔细写上了标签。

entries.en: The postcard showed a quiet street in Portobello.
entries.zh: 明信片上是一条波托贝洛的安静街道。

entries.en: They spent their last evening in Bilbao walking along the river.
entries.zh: 他们在毕尔巴鄂的最后一个晚上沿河散步。

entries.meaningZh: streetwise：熟悉都市生活、懂得应付城市风险的
entries.en: Her streetwise cousin showed her which late-night routes to avoid.
entries.zh: 她那位熟悉都市生活的表亲告诉她深夜应避开哪些路线。

entries.meaningZh: kayaker：皮划艇划手；驾驶皮艇的人
entries.en: A lone kayaker paddled past the reeds.
entries.zh: 一名皮划艇划手独自划过芦苇丛旁。

entries.meaningZh: tantalisingly：诱人却令人难以得到地；令人焦急地
entries.en: The finish line was tantalisingly close.
entries.zh: 终点线近得令人焦急。

entries.en: The VIV brochure grouped the exhibitors by country.
entries.zh: VIV展会手册按国家排列参展商。

entries.en: The periodic table places Ga next to Ge.
entries.zh: 元素周期表把镓放在锗的旁边。

entries.meaningZh: capitalisation：大写字母的使用；英式拼写
entries.en: The editor corrected the capitalisation of every chapter title.
entries.zh: 编辑纠正了每一章标题中的字母大小写。

entries.en: The environmental report lists BOD among its water-quality indicators.
entries.zh: 环境报告把生化需氧量列为水质指标之一。

entries.en: Gustav practised the opening bars before the other musicians arrived.
entries.zh: 其他乐手到来前，古斯塔夫练习了开头几个小节。

entries.en: Winge left a note explaining where the spare key was kept.
entries.zh: 温厄留下一张便条，说明备用钥匙放在哪里。

entries.meaningZh: bop：轻轻的一击，非正式用语
entries.en: The falling cushion gave him a gentle bop on the head.
entries.zh: 掉下来的靠垫轻轻碰了一下他的头。

entries.en: She packed a warm coat for her visit to Edmonton.
entries.zh: 她为去埃德蒙顿的行程带上了一件厚外套。

entries.meaningZh: multilateralism：多边主义；多方合作的政策或做法
entries.en: The essay argues that multilateralism requires patient negotiation.
entries.zh: 这篇文章认为，多边主义需要耐心的谈判。

entries.en: They stopped in Dijon for lunch during the journey.
entries.zh: 他们在旅途中到第戎停留吃午饭。

entries.en: Fitzroy returned the borrowed book with a thank-you note.
entries.zh: 菲茨罗伊还回借来的书，并附了一张感谢便条。

entries.en: The child chose a notebook with Garfield on the cover.
entries.zh: 孩子选了一本封面印着加菲猫的笔记本。

entries.en: She sent me an IM to say the meeting had moved online.
entries.zh: 她给我发了一条即时消息，说会议改到线上举行了。

entries.en: The old garage still had a Texaco sign above its door.
entries.zh: 那家旧修车厂门上仍挂着一块德士古招牌。

entries.meaningZh: aversive：令人厌恶或想要躲避的
entries.en: The alarm's harsh tone was deliberately aversive.
entries.zh: 警报刺耳的声音是特意设计得令人难以忍受的。

entries.meaningZh: overran：overrun的过去式，超过预定时限
entries.en: The discussion overran by nearly half an hour.
entries.zh: 讨论超时了将近半小时。

entries.meaningZh: coattails：燕尾服的后摆；衣服后襟
entries.en: His coattails caught on the chair as he stood up.
entries.zh: 他站起来时，燕尾服的后摆挂在了椅子上。

entries.en: Luigi set three extra places at the dinner table.
entries.zh: 路易吉在餐桌上多摆了三套餐具。

entries.en: The parts list uses BB for the ball-bearing assembly.
entries.zh: 零件表用BB表示滚珠轴承组件。

entries.en: Calvert lent me a waterproof bag for the journey.
entries.zh: 卡尔弗特借给我一个防水袋供旅途中使用。

entries.en: The ferry brochure included a photograph of Hobart's waterfront.
entries.zh: 渡轮宣传册里有一张霍巴特滨水区的照片。

entries.meaningZh: cress：水芹、独行菜等可食用嫩叶植物
entries.en: She added a handful of cress to the egg sandwich.
entries.zh: 她往鸡蛋三明治里加了一把嫩芹叶。

entries.meaningZh: Barbour：巴伯，服装品牌；亦可指该品牌夹克
entries.en: He hung his wet Barbour by the back door.
entries.zh: 他把湿漉漉的巴伯夹克挂在后门旁。

entries.en: The yellow curtains broke the greyness of the room.
entries.zh: 黄色窗帘打破了房间灰暗的色调。

entries.en: She found the instruction booklet for her old Panasonic radio.
entries.zh: 她找到了那台旧松下收音机的说明书。

entries.en: The support team attached the log file to the TR.
entries.zh: 支持团队把日志文件附在了故障报告中。

entries.en: The course outline places GT beside decision theory.
entries.zh: 课程大纲把博弈论与决策论并列。

entries.en: The archivist consulted an ICA publication on preserving records.
entries.zh: 档案管理员查阅了一份国际档案理事会关于保存档案的出版物。

entries.en: The pendant was engraved with the symbol for Capricorn.
entries.zh: 这枚吊坠上刻着摩羯座的符号。

entries.en: The diagram labels the host computer HC.
entries.zh: 示意图用HC标记主机。

entries.en: The travel diary describes the writer's arrival in Saigon.
entries.zh: 游记描述了作者抵达西贡的情景。

entries.meaningZh: heartthrob：大众迷恋的明星或偶像
entries.en: The young actor became a teenage heartthrob almost overnight.
entries.zh: 这位年轻演员几乎一夜之间就成了青少年的梦中偶像。

entries.meaningZh: comme：法语的如同、像，见于借入表达comme il faut
entries.en: Her aunt insisted that everything should be comme il faut.
entries.zh: 她姑妈坚持一切都得合乎礼数。

entries.en: The French note said dans la boîte, meaning inside the box.
entries.zh: 那张法语便条写着dans la boîte，意思是盒子里面。

entries.meaningZh: Esq：Esquire的缩写，旧式或正式的人名后尊称
entries.en: The letter was addressed to Thomas Bell, Esq.
entries.zh: 信封上的收件人写作托马斯·贝尔先生。

entries.en: Portman asked whether the spare room had a desk.
entries.zh: 波特曼问客房里是否有书桌。

entries.meaningZh: muskie：北美狗鱼，muskellunge的非正式名称
entries.en: A picture of a muskie filled the cover of the fishing guide.
entries.zh: 钓鱼指南的封面是一幅北美狗鱼的图片。

entries.meaningZh: lats：拉特，拉脱维亚旧货币单位
entries.en: She kept a one-lats coin as a souvenir.
entries.zh: 她留下一枚面值一拉特的硬币作为纪念。

entries.meaningZh: MV：motor vessel，内燃机船或机动船的船名前缀
entries.en: The ticket gave the vessel's name as MV Harbour Star.
entries.zh: 船票上把船名写作机动船海港之星号。

entries.meaningZh: shiner：发光的东西；非正式亦可指淤青的眼眶
entries.en: He turned up with a shiner after colliding with a door.
entries.zh: 他撞到门后，顶着一只淤青的眼睛出现了。

entries.en: Evan volunteered to drive everyone to the station.
entries.zh: 埃文主动提出开车把大家送到车站。

entries.en: Ezra tucked the receipt into his wallet.
entries.zh: 以斯拉把收据塞进钱包。

entries.meaningZh: choker：紧贴颈部佩戴的项圈式项链
entries.en: She wore a simple black choker with the dress.
entries.zh: 她穿那条连衣裙时戴着一条简单的黑色颈链。

entries.meaningZh: tombola：抽号码赢奖品的筹款游戏
entries.en: We won a box of biscuits at the school tombola.
entries.zh: 我们在学校的抽奖游戏中赢了一盒饼干。

entries.meaningZh: masa：制作玉米饼等食物的玉米面团
entries.en: He pressed the masa into small, even discs.
entries.zh: 他把玉米面团压成大小均匀的小圆饼。

entries.en: The slimline cabinet fitted neatly beside the fridge.
entries.zh: 这个细窄的柜子正好放在冰箱旁。

entries.en: Elijah brought his sketchbook on the train.
entries.zh: 以利亚上火车时带了速写本。

entries.en: They spent the morning exploring the streets of Palermo.
entries.zh: 他们花了整个上午漫步探索巴勒莫的街道。

entries.en: Her suitcase went missing on the flight to Nashville.
entries.zh: 她的行李箱在飞往纳什维尔的航班上丢失了。

entries.en: Rowley put a fresh sheet of paper in the typewriter.
entries.zh: 罗利在打字机里放进一张新纸。

entries.meaningZh: snowpack：地面积存、压实的积雪层
entries.en: A thin snowpack still covered the shaded slope.
entries.zh: 背阴的山坡上仍覆盖着薄薄的积雪层。

entries.en: We need a realistic timeframe for completing the repairs.
entries.zh: 我们需要为完成维修定一个切实可行的期限。

entries.meaningZh: bois：法语的树林或木材，见于地名
entries.en: The French sign marked the woodland as Bois du Moulin.
entries.zh: 法语路牌把这片林地标作磨坊树林。

entries.en: The circuit drawing labels each Josephson junction JJ.
entries.zh: 电路图用JJ标记每个约瑟夫逊结。

entries.en: Peabody donated a box of family letters to the archive.
entries.zh: 皮博迪向档案馆捐赠了一箱家书。

entries.en: Rain followed us through most of our weekend in Bergen.
entries.zh: 我们在卑尔根过周末的大部分时间里都赶上了下雨。

entries.en: The old photograph showed a shopfront bearing the word Banque.
entries.zh: 旧照片上的一家店面写着法语的银行一词。

entries.en: The schematic labels the feed-water line FW.
entries.zh: 示意图用FW标记给水管路。

entries.zh: 项目文件夹中，每个工作包都有一份任务说明书。

entries.meaningZh: DPI：每英寸点数，图像或打印分辨率单位
entries.en: The image was scanned at 300 DPI.
entries.zh: 这幅图像以每英寸300点的分辨率扫描。

entries.en: A failed CRC check indicated that the file might be corrupted.
entries.zh: 循环冗余校验失败表明文件可能已经损坏。

entries.en: The rugby club displayed an RFU coaching handbook in its office.
entries.zh: 这家橄榄球俱乐部在办公室里陈列了一本英格兰橄榄球联合会的教练手册。

entries.en: A fulmar glided low above the waves.
entries.zh: 一只暴风鹱贴着海浪低低滑翔。

entries.en: The historian consulted a declassified DIA report.
entries.zh: 历史学家查阅了一份解密的美国国防情报局报告。

entries.en: Her résumé lists a BSB followed by a postgraduate diploma.
entries.zh: 她的简历列有商学学士学位和之后取得的研究生文凭。

entries.meaningZh: operant：操作性的；行为因后果而改变的
entries.en: The psychology course contrasted operant conditioning with classical conditioning.
entries.zh: 心理学课程比较了操作性条件作用与经典条件作用。

entries.en: Colm brought an extra torch for the walk home.
entries.zh: 科尔姆多带了一支手电筒，供步行回家时使用。

entries.en: The legal glossary translates dum as while.
entries.zh: 法律词汇表把拉丁语dum译为当……时。

entries.en: Monique chose the blue fabric for the curtains.
entries.zh: 莫妮克选了蓝色布料做窗帘。

entries.meaningZh: GHS：全球化学品统一分类和标签制度
entries.en: The glossary explains the GHS symbols shown on product labels.
entries.zh: 词汇表解释了产品标签上的全球化学品统一分类和标签制度符号。

entries.meaningZh: sabina：圆柏属植物名称中的拉丁成分
entries.en: The field guide lists Juniperus sabina among the junipers.
entries.zh: 野外指南把沙地柏列入圆柏属植物。

entries.en: They stopped in Usk to buy bread for the journey.
entries.zh: 他们在厄斯克停下来买旅途中吃的面包。

entries.meaningZh: dace：雅罗鱼类的小型淡水鱼
entries.en: Small dace gathered in the shallow water near the bridge.
entries.zh: 几条小雅罗鱼聚在桥边的浅水中。

entries.en: The group printed the boyz on their homemade poster.
entries.zh: 这群人在自制海报上写了the boyz。

entries.meaningZh: Himmler：希姆莱，姓氏；常见于纳粹德国历史
entries.en: The historian examined Himmler's correspondence as evidence of the regime's crimes.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了希姆莱的通信，将其作为该政权罪行的证据。

entries.en: The staff directory lists her title as Asst Mgr.
entries.zh: 员工名录把她的职务列为助理经理。

entries.meaningZh: Sampdoria：桑普多利亚，意大利足球俱乐部
entries.en: The café wall was covered with old Sampdoria scarves.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆的墙上挂满了旧的桑普多利亚围巾。

entries.en: She saw the coincidence as a kind of karmic balance.
entries.zh: 她把这场巧合看作一种因果平衡。

entries.en: The drug-reference index lists PCP under phencyclidine.
entries.zh: 药物参考索引在苯环己哌啶条目下列出了PCP这一缩写。

entries.meaningZh: codependency：过度相互依赖，尤其涉及不健康关系模式
entries.en: The counsellor's book explores codependency within families.
entries.zh: 这位咨询师的书探讨了家庭中的过度依赖关系。

entries.en: The analytical-methods chapter compares AES with other spectroscopic techniques.
entries.zh: 分析方法一章将原子发射光谱法与其他光谱技术作了比较。

entries.en: The invoice is dated 18 Jul.
entries.zh: 发票上的日期为7月18日。

entries.en: The image caption identifies the instrument as an SEM.
entries.zh: 图片说明把所用仪器标为扫描电子显微镜。

entries.en: The annual report shows EPS beside net profit.
entries.zh: 年报在净利润旁列出了每股收益。

entries.meaningZh: Sampras：桑普拉斯，网球运动员姓氏
entries.en: The documentary includes an interview with Sampras.
entries.zh: 纪录片里有一段对桑普拉斯的采访。

entries.en: The article explains the WBO initials printed on the belt.
entries.zh: 文章解释了金腰带上印着的世界拳击组织缩写。

entries.meaningZh: minibar：旅馆客房内放饮料和小食品的小冰箱或小吧台
entries.en: The hotel charged separately for drinks from the minibar.
entries.zh: 酒店对客房小冰箱里的饮料另行收费。

entries.meaningZh: Scrooge：吝啬鬼，源自狄更斯人物名
entries.en: Don't be such a Scrooge—buy your friends a round.
entries.zh: 别这么吝啬了，请朋友们喝一轮吧。

entries.meaningZh: hélice：法语的螺旋桨；英语通常用propeller
entries.en: The French parts list calls the propeller une hélice.
entries.zh: 法语零件表把螺旋桨写作une hélice。

entries.en: The workshop counts towards her annual CPD.
entries.zh: 这次工作坊计入她的年度持续专业发展学习。

entries.en: The application needs the correct RTE to start.
entries.zh: 这个应用程序需要正确的运行环境才能启动。

entries.en: The biochemistry chart places CDP between CMP and CTP.
entries.zh: 生物化学图表把胞苷二磷酸放在胞苷一磷酸和胞苷三磷酸之间。

entries.en: The telecommunications diagram shows an SSP connected to the signalling network.
entries.zh: 通信示意图显示业务交换点与信令网相连。

entries.en: Sven waited until everyone had a seat before beginning the story.
entries.zh: 斯文等大家都有座位后才开始讲故事。

entries.en: The translation worksheet labels English as the TL.
entries.zh: 翻译练习表把英语标作目标语言。

entries.meaningZh: SDI：信息选择传播；定题信息服务
entries.en: The library's SDI service sends researchers updates on their chosen topics.
entries.zh: 图书馆的定题信息服务向研究人员发送其选定主题的最新资料。

entries.en: Kyi brought a carefully labelled folder to the interview.
entries.zh: Kyi带着一个仔细标好的文件夹来参加面谈。

entries.meaningZh: doozy：出色或惊人的人或事，非正式用语
entries.en: That final question was a real doozy.
entries.zh: 最后一道题可真够厉害的。

entries.meaningZh: Cheng：成或程等汉语姓氏的罗马字形式
entries.en: Cheng checked the microphone before the audience arrived.
entries.zh: Cheng在观众到来前检查了麦克风。

entries.en: The protein catalogue uses rHA for recombinant human albumin.
entries.zh: 蛋白质目录用rHA表示重组人白蛋白。

entries.meaningZh: SAMs：surface-to-air missiles，地对空导弹的复数缩写
entries.en: The museum labels several retired missiles as SAMs.
entries.zh: 博物馆把几枚退役导弹标为地对空导弹。

entries.meaningZh: blandness：平淡；缺乏鲜明特点或味道
entries.en: A little lemon juice relieved the blandness of the sauce.
entries.zh: 一点柠檬汁改善了酱汁寡淡的味道。

entries.en: The pathology glossary expands MGN as membranous glomerulonephritis.
entries.zh: 病理学词汇表将MGN展开为膜性肾小球肾炎。

entries.meaningZh: playdate：为孩子安排的一起玩耍的约会
entries.en: We arranged a playdate for the children on Saturday.
entries.zh: 我们安排孩子们星期六一起玩。

entries.en: The nutrition textbook identifies DHA as an omega-3 fatty acid.
entries.zh: 营养学教材把二十二碳六烯酸列为一种欧米伽-3脂肪酸。

entries.en: The programme can randomise the order of the quiz questions.
entries.zh: 这个程序可以随机排列测验题目的顺序。

entries.meaningZh: Frisbee：飞盘，原为商标名，亦用于普通称呼
entries.en: They threw a Frisbee back and forth on the grass.
entries.zh: 他们在草地上来回抛飞盘。

entries.en: A sudden downdraft sent the loose leaves swirling.
entries.zh: 一股突如其来的下降气流使落叶旋转起来。

entries.en: Moussa carried a folding stool to the riverside.
entries.zh: 穆萨带着一张折叠凳来到河边。

entries.meaningZh: Yong：勇、永等汉语名字的罗马字形式
entries.en: Yong left his camera on the kitchen counter.
entries.zh: Yong把相机放在了厨房操作台上。

entries.en: The chemistry chart gives HCl as the formula for hydrogen chloride.
entries.zh: 化学图表给出的氯化氢化学式为HCl。

entries.en: She sliced a ripe nectarine into the fruit salad.
entries.zh: 她把一个熟油桃切片放进水果沙拉。

entries.en: The auditor consulted an IIA publication before drafting the training notes.
entries.zh: 审计师起草培训笔记前查阅了一份内部审计师协会的出版物。

entries.meaningZh: bobo：布尔乔亚波希米亚族；兼具中产消费与波希米亚风格的人
entries.en: The essay uses bobo to describe the affluent customers at the artisan market.
entries.zh: 文章用布尔乔亚波希米亚族形容手工艺市场里富裕的顾客。

entries.meaningZh: Mercian：英格兰古代麦西亚地区或其方言的
entries.en: The manuscript preserves several Mercian spellings.
entries.zh: 手稿保留了几种麦西亚方言的拼写。

entries.en: The display identifies the system as OTH radar.
entries.zh: 显示说明把这个系统称为超视距雷达。

entries.en: Zhao brought a large map for the group discussion.
entries.zh: 赵带来了一张大地图供小组讨论。

entries.meaningZh: mellitus：拉丁医学名称中表示甜的、蜜样的限定成分
entries.en: The index distinguishes diabetes mellitus from diabetes insipidus.
entries.zh: 索引区分了糖尿病与尿崩症。

entries.en: The equipment list includes a CSU for the communications link.
entries.zh: 设备清单中有一个用于通信链路的信道服务单元。

entries.meaningZh: Grumman：格鲁曼，航空制造商名称
entries.en: The aviation museum displayed a Grumman aircraft beside its design drawings.
entries.zh: 航空博物馆把一架格鲁曼飞机与其设计图一起展出。

entries.meaningZh: jumpstart：使迅速启动或恢复活力
entries.en: The small grant helped jumpstart the community project.
entries.zh: 这笔小额资助帮助社区项目迅速启动。

entries.meaningZh: PTT：邮政、电话与电报业务的合称
entries.en: The archive contains old PTT notices about telephone charges.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着邮电部门关于电话资费的旧通知。

entries.en: The shipping form gives the destination country as DK.
entries.zh: 运单把目的国写作丹麦的国家代码DK。

entries.en: The handwritten table uses dn to mark a decrease.
entries.zh: 手写表格用dn标记下降。

entries.en: The systems chapter introduces SDA as a way of reducing repeated data entry.
entries.zh: 系统一章将源数据自动化介绍为减少重复数据录入的一种方式。

entries.en: The archived brochure carries the AMO name on its cover.
entries.zh: 存档宣传册的封面印着AMO公司名称。

entries.meaningZh: factsheet：事实资料单；简明资料页
entries.en: The council published a factsheet explaining the new recycling bins.
entries.zh: 市政部门发布了一份简明资料，说明新回收箱的使用安排。

entries.en: The public-health glossary lists CHD as coronary heart disease.
entries.zh: 公共卫生词汇表将CHD列为冠心病的缩写。

entries.meaningZh: IRC：Internet Relay Chat，互联网中继聊天
entries.en: They first met in an IRC channel devoted to old computers.
entries.zh: 他们最初在一个讨论旧电脑的IRC频道里相识。

entries.en: The physics diagram shows KE increasing as the trolley speeds up.
entries.zh: 物理示意图显示，小车速度加快时动能增大。

entries.meaningZh: WRU：who are you，身份询问信号
entries.en: The terminal log records a WRU request followed by an identification reply.
entries.zh: 终端日志记录了一条身份询问请求和随后的一条身份回复。

entries.en: The research team submitted its proposal to the IRB.
entries.zh: 研究团队向机构伦理审查委员会提交了提案。

entries.en: The system documentation assigns connection management to the CCP.
entries.zh: 系统文档把连接管理交给通信控制程序。

entries.meaningZh: walla：wallah的变体，某项工作的从业者
entries.en: The old travel account describes a tea walla serving passengers at the station.
entries.zh: 旧游记描写了一名在车站给旅客卖茶的茶贩。

entries.en: The French guide labelled the route as a promenade en montagne.
entries.zh: 法语指南把这条路线称为山地散步路线。

entries.en: She had her old Frye boots resoled.
entries.zh: 她给自己的旧弗赖伊靴子换了鞋底。

entries.en: The aviation display compared an SST with a conventional passenger aircraft.
entries.zh: 航空展陈比较了超音速运输机与常规客机。

entries.en: The chart cites INE as its source.
entries.zh: 图表把西班牙国家统计局列为数据来源。

entries.en: Eloise tied the parcel with a length of red string.
entries.zh: 埃洛伊丝用一段红绳绑好包裹。

entries.en: The NPC offered the player a map of the village.
entries.zh: 这个非玩家角色给玩家提供了一张村庄地图。

entries.meaningZh: homeworker：在家从事有报酬工作的人
entries.en: The survey asked homeworkers how much space they had for their work.
entries.zh: 调查询问在家工作者有多少工作空间。

entries.en: Dowty set the alarm early for the morning train.
entries.zh: 道蒂为赶早班火车把闹钟定得很早。

entries.meaningZh: LJJ：林俊杰汉语拼音姓名的非正式首字母缩写
entries.en: The fan wrote LJJ above a photograph of JJ Lin.
entries.zh: 粉丝在林俊杰的照片上方写了LJJ。

entries.en: Wolfenden carried the empty trays back to the kitchen.
entries.zh: 沃尔芬登把空托盘端回厨房。

entries.en: The cockpit diagram labels the RMI beside the other navigation instruments.
entries.zh: 驾驶舱示意图把无线电磁方位指示器标在其他导航仪器旁。

entries.en: The old game offered a separate EGA graphics mode.
entries.zh: 这款旧游戏提供单独的增强型图形适配器显示模式。

entries.en: The staff meeting included a discussion of PRP.
entries.zh: 员工会议讨论了绩效工资。

entries.meaningZh: metastasis：转移病灶；标准英语形式
entries.en: The review distinguishes a primary tumour from a metastasis.
entries.zh: 综述区分了原发肿瘤与转移病灶。

entries.en: Alia brought a small notebook to record the interview.
entries.zh: 艾莉娅带了一本小笔记本记录采访。

entries.meaningZh: subgenre：次类型；某一体裁下的分支类型
entries.en: The course explores science fiction as a subgenre of popular literature.
entries.zh: 这门课探讨作为通俗文学分支类型的科幻文学。

entries.en: The diagram compares IgG with other classes of antibody.
entries.zh: 示意图将免疫球蛋白G与其他抗体类别作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: VOR：甚高频全向无线电信标
entries.en: The navigation chart marks a VOR near the coast.
entries.zh: 导航图在海岸附近标出了一处甚高频全向信标。

entries.meaningZh: PCX：一种图像文件格式或其扩展名
entries.en: The archive contained several scanned pictures saved as PCX files.
entries.zh: 档案中有几幅保存为PCX文件的扫描图片。

entries.en: The factory uses MRP to coordinate component orders.
entries.zh: 工厂利用物料需求计划协调零部件订购。

entries.en: The catalogue entry reads 240 pp., illus.
entries.zh: 目录条目写着240页，附插图。

entries.en: The contract schedule lists the CFE separately from the owner's equipment.
entries.zh: 合同附表把承包商供应的设备与业主的设备分开列示。

entries.en: The grid report includes a section on TLR events.
entries.zh: 电网报告有一节记录输电负荷削减事件。

entries.en: The environmental report describes the plant's FGD equipment.
entries.zh: 环境报告描述了工厂的烟气脱硫设备。

entries.en: The memory map labels the temporary storage area BUF.
entries.zh: 内存图把临时存储区标记为BUF。

entries.en: The report cites an ICO publication on coffee markets.
entries.zh: 报告引用了一份国际咖啡组织关于咖啡市场的出版物。

entries.en: The delayed train is expected to arrive imminently.
entries.zh: 延误的火车预计马上就会到达。

entries.en: The engine diagram marks TDC at the top of the piston's travel.
entries.zh: 发动机示意图在活塞行程最高点标出上止点。

entries.meaningZh: Boz：查尔斯·狄更斯使用过的笔名博兹
entries.en: The display included an early publication signed Boz.
entries.zh: 展品中有一份署名博兹的早期出版物。

entries.en: The spectroscopy glossary gives PMR as an older name for proton magnetic resonance.
entries.zh: 光谱学词汇表把PMR列为质子磁共振的旧称。

entries.en: The telecommunications diagram labels the dial-pulse receiver DPR.
entries.zh: 通信示意图用DPR标记拨号脉冲接收机。

entries.en: The weather vane pointed SSE.
entries.zh: 风向标指向南南东。

entries.en: The network manual assigns fault reporting to SNM.
entries.zh: 网络手册把故障报告列入信令网管理。

entries.en: The audio manual has a short section on SNC.
entries.zh: 音响手册有一个介绍立体声噪声控制的简短章节。

entries.meaningZh: propria：拉丁语固有的，见于lamina propria固有层
entries.en: The histology diagram labels the lamina propria beneath the epithelium.
entries.zh: 组织学示意图标出了上皮下面的固有层。

entries.en: The chart labels its flow-rate column FLR.
entries.zh: 图表用FLR标记流率一栏。

entries.en: Beddow brought a folding table for the outdoor stall.
entries.zh: 贝多为户外摊位带来了一张折叠桌。

entries.meaningZh: WMC：美国战时人力委员会，历史机构
entries.en: The historian found a WMC notice in the factory's wartime records.
entries.zh: 历史学家在工厂的战时档案中找到了一份战时人力委员会通知。

entries.meaningZh: deindustrialization：去工业化；工业活动或工业就业的衰退
entries.en: The book examines how deindustrialization changed the town's economy.
entries.zh: 这本书研究了去工业化如何改变这座城镇的经济。

entries.en: Cranko pencilled a reminder in the margin of the programme.
entries.zh: 克兰科在节目单边上用铅笔写下一条提醒。

entries.meaningZh: GOG：美国妇科肿瘤学研究组织的历史简称
entries.en: The bibliography includes a paper attributed to the GOG.
entries.zh: 参考文献中有一篇署名妇科肿瘤学研究组织的论文。

entries.meaningZh: jonquil：长寿花水仙；黄水仙的一类
entries.en: A pot of yellow jonquils stood beside the window.
entries.zh: 窗边放着一盆黄色长寿花水仙。
